host.description: The Bastion host to connect to

port.description: The SSH port to connect to (default: 22)

private_key_file.description: Path to SSH private key file

private_key_passphrase.description: Passphrase for the SSH private key

strict_host_key_checking.description: Enable strict host key checking (default: true)

use_agent.description: Use SSH agent for authentication (default: false)

account.description: The name of the Bastion account

always_active.description: Whether the account is always active.

egress_session_multiplexing.description: Egress session multiplexing policy. Valid values: yes, no, default.

egress_strict_host_key_checking.description: Egress strict host key checking policy. Valid values: yes, accept-new, no, ask, default, bypass.

idle_ignore.description: Whether to ignore idle timeouts for this account.

immutable_key.description: Whether the account's public key is immutable.

max_inactive_days.description: Maximum number of days of inactivity before the account is considered inactive.

mfa_password_required.description: MFA password policy. Valid values: yes, no, bypass.

mfa_totp_required.description: MFA TOTP policy. Valid values: yes, no, bypass.

no_key.description: Whether to create the account without an initial public key.

osh_only.description: Whether the account can only use osh (bastion) commands.

pam_auth_bypass.description: Whether PAM authentication is bypassed for this account.

personal_egress_mfa_required.description: Personal egress MFA policy. Valid values: password, totp, any, none.

pubkey_auth_optional.description: Whether public key authentication is optional for this account.

public_key.description: The public key to assign to the account upon creation.

ttl.description: Time to live for the account in seconds.

uid.description: The UID of the Bastion account. Mutually exclusive with uid_auto.

uid_auto.description: Whether to automatically assign a UID. Mutually exclusive with uid.

account.description: The name of the Bastion account

command.description: The command to grant to the account

block.description: Manages a Bastion account command grant

account.description: The name of the Bastion account

policy.description: The PIV policy for the account. Valid values: `default` (use bastion global policy), `enforce` (only PIV-verified keys allowed, disables non-PIV keys immediately), `never` (never require PIV keys regardless of global setting). Note: The `grace` policy must be managed using the ephemeral resource.

block.description: Manages the PIV (Personal Identity Verification) policy for a Bastion account's ingress keys. This resource manages stable PIV policies. For temporary grace periods, use the `ephemeral:bastion_account_piv_grace` ephemeral resource.

aclkeepers.description: The ACL keepers of the Bastion group

gatekeepers.description: The gatekeepers of the Bastion group

group.description: The name of the Bastion group

guest_ttl_limit.description: Maximum TTL (time to live) for guest accesses in seconds.

idle_kill_timeout.description: Idle kill timeout in seconds. After this duration of inactivity, the session will be terminated.

idle_lock_timeout.description: Idle lock timeout in seconds. After this duration of inactivity, the session will be locked.

key_algo.description: The SSH key algorithm for the group's initial key. Valid values: ed25519, rsa2048, rsa4096, rsa8192, ecdsa256, ecdsa384, ecdsa521. Defaults to ed25519. This value is only used during creation and cannot be changed afterward.

members.description: The members of the Bastion group

mfa_required.description: MFA policy for the group. Valid values: password, totp, any, none. If not specified, the group's current setting is preserved.

owner.description: The owner of the Bastion group. Changing this will transfer ownership to the new account.

owners.description: The owners of the Bastion group

try_personal_keys.description: Whether to try personal ssh keys for group accesses. Defaults to false.

account.description: The account name to add as an ACL keeper

group.description: The name of the Bastion group

block.description: Manages a Bastion group ACL keeper membership

account.description: The account name to add as a gatekeeper

group.description: The name of the Bastion group

block.description: Manages a Bastion group gatekeeper membership

account.description: The account to grant guest access to

group.description: The Bastion group name owning the server access

ip.description: IP or subnet of the server access target (hostname does not work)

port.description: Port of the access target, use '*' to allow ssh access to all ports

protocol.description: Protocol to grant access for. Valid values are 'sftp', 'scpupload', 'scpdownload', 'rsync', 'portforward'. When set, 'user' must be empty.

proxy_ip.description: IP address of the proxy server

proxy_user.description: Username for the proxy server, use '*' to allow all users

remote_port.description: Remote port forwarded from the target server to The Bastion

ttl.description: Time to live for the guest access in seconds

user.description: Username for the server access. Cannot be used together with `protocol`

block.description:
Manages a Bastion group guest access.

A guest access grants a specific account access to a subset of a group's server accesses.
Note that the server access must exist in the group before granting guest access to it.

Some features like proxyjump accesses and port forwardings are only supported when running [The Bastion fork](https://github.com/adfinis-forks/the-bastion) from Adfinis.

account.description: The account name to add as a member

group.description: The name of the Bastion group

block.description: Manages a Bastion group member membership

account.description: The account name to add as an owner

group.description: The name of the Bastion group

block.description: Manages a Bastion group owner membership

force.description: Force adding the access even if it cannot be verified

force_key.description: Force a specific SSH key for the access

force_password.description: Force a specific password for the access

group.description: The Bastion group name to add the access to

ip.description: IP or subnet of the access target. (hostname does not work)

port.description: Port of the access target, use '*' to allow ssh access to all ports

protocol.description: Protocol to grant access for. Valid values are 'sftp', 'scpupload', 'scpdownload', 'rsync', 'portforward'. When set, 'user' must be empty. A base access must already exist for the server.

proxy_user.description: Username for the proxy server, use '*' to allow all users

remote_port.description: Remote port forwarded from the target server to The Bastion

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds for the access

user.description: Username for the access, use '*' to allow ssh access for all users.

Manages a Bastion group access.
